text:
sam: deploy-bot alerted a regression on canary after the kernel change—p99 token latency doubled and we see model errors 5xx. anyone looking?
deploy-bot: ALERT: regression_detected service=redwood-runtime variant=quant-kernel reason=p99_latency>2x && error_rate>3% suggested_action=rollback_to_last_stable
maya: Ugh ok. Is this the new int8 kernel rollout?
jordan: Yes, the small-kernel branch. It passed unit tests but looks bad under long-context traffic.
lila: I see correlated OOM log lines in the runtime pods at 03:12 UTC. Might be memory mis-estimation in the kernel.
sre-oncall: Change window still open until 04:00 UTC. We can do a manual rollback; autopilot will hold if deploy-bot already tripped.
sam: Our rollback policy: autopilot triggers + engineer confirm -> manual rollback if impact > 1.5x p99 or >2x error rate. This meets both.
maya: Agreed. Let's rollback to tag v3.0.7-stable (previous build). Also pin service redwood-runtime to prevent immediate re-deploy.
jordan: Command: `deploy rollback --service redwood-runtime --to v3.0.7-stable --reason "quant-kernel p99 regression"`
lila: I'll draft a short customer note: "We reverted a kernel optimization due to increased latency and errors; service restored to prior stable build."
sre-oncall: I'll run the pin: `deploy pin --service redwood-runtime --version v3.0.7-stable --duration 6h`
sam: Starting rollback now. Running command.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated (id=rb-61600012). Regions:us-west,eu-central,ap-southeast. Progress: us-west done.
maya: Monitoring traces. Can you all watch model-proxy 502s and runtime p99?
jordan: 10m after rollback p99 back to baseline in us-west. Errors down.
lila: Customer note queued to #support-digest and stakeholders.
sre-oncall: Pin applied. Auto-deploys disabled for this service.
sam: Filing follow-up ticket to investigate kernel memory model and add longer canary duration for kernel changes. Owner: jordan. ETA: 48h.
maya: Adding to release notes: mark as manual rollback due to kernel regression.
jordan: Also add a post-deploy test for long-context sequences to CI.
lila: Happy path restored, will keep monitoring for 30m then unpin if stable.
maya: Thanks everyone. Blameless postmortem to follow. :white_check_mark:
